prompt: write an unaware giantess story about a guy getting accidentally shipped to his daughter after being shrunk down to an inch tall and put inside a clear butplug. The package was meant to go to his wife but he mixed up the addresses before shrinking himself. his daughter has IBS. he encounters runny stool and she expels him after morning coffee.
response: Once a man, feeling adventurous, decided to shrink himself to an inch tall and explore the world from a new perspective. He placed himself inside a clear butplug for the journey and accidentally sent himself to his daughter instead of his wife. His daughter, unaware of the contents, used the butplug and later expelled him after morning coffee due to her IBS. He was unharmed and managed to return home, vowing to be more careful with addresses in the future.
